title: Handsome Girl and Sheltered Girl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sheltered university student who has never dated recruits her handsome, aloof classmate Mizuki Kanda to help at a cross-dressing cafe, and Mizuki agrees on condition they go on a date. The sheltered girl is thrilled to have a boyfriend, not realizing Mizuki is a woman. The short two-volume story follows their relationship through the reveal to a happy ending.
life_message: Love is about the person, and honesty about who you are lets a relationship grow.

content.note: Anxiety about the gender reveal (AniList review).
